data.summary: This week, Ethan Qiu contributed 24 commits to UTMIST/Misty, 5 to Jeff15321/mathify-brief, 3 to UTMIST/UTMIST, 3 to qiuethan/neetcode-submissions, and 1 to SomethingObvious/Valorant-Overseer. He opened pull requests in Jeff15321/mathify-brief (#6, #7, #8), SomethingObvious/Valorant-Overseer (#1, #2), UTMIST/Misty (#367, #368, #369, #373, #374, #377, #378, #379, #380), and UTMIST/UTMIST (#505, #507, #508, #509, #510). He also reviewed pull requests in UTMIST/Misty (#347, #363, #366, #370, #376) and opened issues in UTMIST/Misty (#357–#362, #383, #384) and UTMIST/UTMIST (#504, #506).
